name: Arjun Verma
bio:
Arjun's journey into motorsport HR was somewhat unconventional, beginning with a degree in organizational psychology followed by a stint in a tech startup. He found the fast-paced, high-stakes environment of motorsport incredibly appealing, seeing parallels to the tech world's competitive edge. He joined Aston Martin five years ago, initially focusing on talent acquisition before transitioning into the HR Manager role.

Arjun is known for his data-driven approach to HR. He firmly believes in using metrics to measure employee satisfaction and identify areas for improvement. His pragmatic mindset helps him navigate the complex dynamics of a motorsport team, ensuring that personnel policies are both fair and effective. He's particularly focused on initiatives that promote diversity and inclusion within the team, striving to create a more welcoming environment for individuals from all backgrounds. 

What sets Arjun apart is his ability to bridge the gap between the technical and human aspects of motorsport. He understands the pressures engineers and drivers face, and he uses this knowledge to develop HR strategies that support their well-being and performance. He's also a passionate advocate for continuous learning, constantly seeking ways to upskill team members and keep them at the forefront of their fields.
